payload.action_summary: Multi-dashboard publish: extend build_engine.py with a nested output mode (staging dashboards/<id>/ with its own dashboard.yaml + views/ + button_card_templates.yaml copy) and wire CI to build m2m_nextgen alongside the primary svitlo artifact, so every deploy ships both. m2m_nextgen becomes reachable on Edge at /config/edge-state/dashboards/m2m_nextgen/dashboard.yaml after a one-time manual lovelace.dashboards registration by the operator (outside agent scope per STD-01/ADR-0037 lineage).
preserve_behavior: root staging artifact (svitlo) byte-for-byte unchanged; nested build never touches root dashboard.yaml/views (pinned by test_nested_build_is_isolated_from_root_artifact)
publish_edge.sh unchanged (git add -A already carries the nested subtree)
build_engine.py default CLI invocation still builds svitlo at staging root
